name: Portrait of Loss
source:
You play as the deadpan emo-boy Adrian, who leads a fragile relationship straight into its grave whilst navigating two different kinds of loss. His partner, and his soul.

What first appears to be a story about the grief of losing a loved one slowly unravels to reveal something more...

[From [url=https://archiepvc.itch.io/portrait-of-loss]itch.io[/url]]
